name: UpdateCloudGtmInstanceConfigAlert

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese

en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

zh-CN：中文
en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The client must generate a unique value for this parameter. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name instance configuration. A GTM instance can have two configurations for the same access domain name if you configure both A and AAAA records. The ConfigId uniquely identifies a configuration
parameters.help_zh: 域名实例配置id，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en:
The alert configuration mode for the instance. Valid values:

global: The instance inherits the global alert configuration.

instance_config: The instance uses a custom alert configuration
parameters.help_zh:
实例告警配置模式：

global：继承全局报警配置，即实例采用全局告警配置

instance_config：自定义报警配置
parameters.name: alert_mode

parameters.help_en: A list of alert notification groups
parameters.name: alert_group

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable DingTalk notifications. Valid values:

true: Enabled. When an alert is triggered, a DingTalk message is sent.

false: Disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否配置钉钉报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送钉钉通知

false：未配置
fields.name: dingtalk_notice

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable email notifications. Valid values:

true: Enabled. When an alert is triggered, an email is sent.

false: Disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否配置邮件报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送邮件通知

false：未配置
fields.name: email_notice

fields.help_en:
The type of alert event. Valid values:

addr_alert: The address is unavailable.

addr_resume: The address has recovered.

addr_pool_unavailable: The address pool is unavailable.

addr_pool_available: The address pool has recovered
fields.help_zh:
报警事件类型：

addr_alert：地址不可用

addr_resume：地址恢复可用

addr_pool_unavailable：地址池不可用

addr_pool_available：地址池恢复可用
fields.name: notice_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable text message notifications. Valid values:

true: Enabled. When an alert is triggered, a text message is sent.

false: Disabled.

Note: Text message notifications are supported only on the China site (aliyun.com)
fields.help_zh:
是否配置短信报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送短信通知

false：未配置

仅中国站支持短信通知，国际站不支持短信通知
fields.name: sms_notice

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
本次操作是否成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
